summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund S filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of approximately 209,520 common shares at $24.64 per share for about $5.2 million to accredited investors under Regulation D. The filing also provided routine portfolio statistics as of July 31, 2026, including loan commitments and composition. There is no special-situation event; the share issuance is an ordinary capital raise by a business development company, and the portfolio disclosure is routine. No change of control, restructuring, or strategic action is indicated. Watch for continued periodic fundraising and portfolio updates.
